[RTCT.9.1] Compile-side errors are issued by the compiler
and are not part of the runtime `ds_status_t` space
([LERR.8]) — they carry no number and appear in no band:

```
DS_VALIDATE_COMPILE_MISSING_DSRT             /* realtime without sibling .dsrt */
DS_VALIDATE_COMPILE_DSRT_WITHOUT_REALTIME    /* .dsrt present, realtime not */
DS_VALIDATE_COMPILE_CONTRACT_INCOMPLETE      /* missing node/series entry, missing required scalar */
```
